ja: 大砲やミサイルなど全身武器だらけ“ギロロロボMk-II”登場。
ロボ形態からタンク形態へ変形。
ロボに乗り込むギロロ伍長も手足が可動。
ギロロ伍長はロボのコクピットにもなるソーサーに乗せることが可能。
en: Full of full-body weapons such as cannons and missiles, "Girororo Robo Mk-II" appeared.
Transforms from Robo form to tank form.
Corporal Giroro, who gets into the robot, also has movable limbs.
Corporal Giroro can be placed on a saucer that can also be used as Robo's cockpit.
